# Synopsis

`pandoc` [*options*] [*input-file*]...

# Description

Pandoc is a [Haskell] library for converting from one markup format to
another, and a command-line tool that uses this library.

Pandoc can convert between numerous markup and word processing formats,
including, but not limited to, various flavors of [Markdown], [HTML],
[LaTeX] and [Word docx]. For the full lists of input and output formats,
see the `--from` and `--to` [options below][General options].
Pandoc can also produce [PDF] output: see [creating a PDF], below.

Pandoc's enhanced version of Markdown includes syntax for [tables],
[definition lists], [metadata blocks], [footnotes], [citations], [math],
and much more.  See below under [Pandoc's Markdown].

Pandoc has a modular design: it consists of a set of readers, which parse
text in a given format and produce a native representation of the document
(an _abstract syntax tree_ or AST), and a set of writers, which convert
this native representation into a target format. Thus, adding an input
or output format requires only adding a reader or writer. Users can also
run custom [pandoc filters] to modify the intermediate AST.

Because pandoc's intermediate representation of a document is less
expressive than many of the formats it converts between, one should
not expect perfect conversions between every format and every other.
Pandoc attempts to preserve the structural elements of a document, but
not formatting details such as margin size.  And some document elements,
such as complex tables, may not fit into pandoc's simple document
model.  While conversions from pandoc's Markdown to all formats aspire
to be perfect, conversions from formats more expressive than pandoc's
Markdown can be expected to be lossy.

## Using pandoc

If no *input-files* are specified, input is read from *stdin*.
Output goes to *stdout* by default. For output to a file,
use the `-o`/`--output` option:

    pandoc -o output.html input.txt

By default, pandoc produces a document fragment. To produce a standalone
document (e.g. a valid HTML file including `<head>` and `<body>`),
use the `-s` or `--standalone` flag:

    pandoc -s -o output.html input.txt

For more information on how standalone documents are produced, see
[Templates] below.

If multiple input files are given, pandoc will concatenate them all (with
blank lines between them) before parsing. (Use `--file-scope` to parse files
individually.)

## Specifying formats

The format of the input and output can be specified explicitly using
command-line options.  The input format can be specified using the
`-f/--from` option, the output format using the `-t/--to` option.
Thus, to convert `hello.txt` from Markdown to LaTeX, you could type:

    pandoc -f markdown -t latex hello.txt

To convert `hello.html` from HTML to Markdown:

    pandoc -f html -t markdown hello.html

Supported input and output formats are listed below under [Options]
(see `-f` for input formats and `-t` for output formats).  You
can also use `pandoc --list-input-formats` and
`pandoc --list-output-formats` to print lists of supported
formats.

If the input or output format is not specified explicitly, pandoc
will attempt to guess it from the extensions of the filenames.
Thus, for example,

    pandoc -o hello.tex hello.txt

will convert `hello.txt` from Markdown to LaTeX.  If no output file
is specified (so that output goes to *stdout*), or if the output file's
extension is unknown, the output format will default to HTML.
If no input file is specified (so that input comes from *stdin*), or
if the input files' extensions are unknown, the input format will
be assumed to be Markdown.

import re
from pandoc.ast import (
    Document, Meta, Attr, Header, Para, Plain, CodeBlock, RawBlock, BlockQuote,
    BulletList, OrderedList, HorizontalRule, Div, Table,
    Str, Space, SoftBreak, LineBreak, Emph, Strong, Strikeout, Superscript, Subscript,
    Code, Math, Link, Image, RawInline, Note, Span, inlines_to_string
)

def make_auto_identifier(text, existing_ids):
    s = text.lower()
    s = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'[^\w\s\-]', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'[\s\-]+', '-', s).strip('-')
    
    m = re.match(r'^[0-9_\-]+([a-z].*)$', s)
    if m:
        s = m.group(1)
        
    if not s or not re.search(r'[a-z]', s):
        s = 'section'
        
    base = s
    count = 1
    while s in existing_ids:
        s = f'{base}-{count}'
        count += 1
        
    existing_ids.add(s)
    return s

def parse_header_attr(attr_str):
    if not attr_str:
        return Attr()
    ident = ""
    classes = []
    kvs = []
    
    # Extract {#id}
    m_id = re.search(r'#([\w\-]+)', attr_str)
    if m_id:
        ident = m_id.group(1)
        
    # Extract .class
    for m_cls in re.finditer(r'\.([\w\-]+)', attr_str):
        classes.append(m_cls.group(1))
        
    # Extract key="val" or key=val
    for m_kv in re.finditer(r'([\w\-]+)=["\']?([^"\'\s]+)["\']?', attr_str):
        kvs.append([m_kv.group(1), m_kv.group(2)])
        
    return Attr(ident, classes, kvs)

def parse_inlines(text, footnotes_map=None):
    if not text:
        return []
        
    inlines = []
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    
    while i < n:
        # Escaped character
        if text[i] == '\\' and i + 1 < n:
            ch = text[i+1]
            if ch == '\n':
                inlines.append(LineBreak())
                i += 2
                continue
            elif ch in r'`*_{}[]()#+-.!~^$\':':
                inlines.append(Str(ch))
                i += 2
                continue
            else:
                inlines.append(Str('\\'))
                i += 1
                continue
                
        # Math: $$ or $
        if text[i] == '$':
            if i + 1 < n and text[i+1] == '$':
                m = re.match(r'^\$\$(.*?)\$\$', text[i:], re.DOTALL)
                if m:
                    inlines.append(Math("DisplayMath", m.group(1)))
                    i += len(m.group(0))
                    continue
            m = re.match(r'^\$([^\$\n]+?)\$', text[i:])
            if m:
                inlines.append(Math("InlineMath", m.group(1)))
                i += len(m.group(0))
                continue
                
        # Inline code: `code`
        if text[i] == '`':
            m = re.match(r'^(?P<ticks>`+)(?P<code>.*?)(?P=ticks)', text[i:], re.DOTALL)
            if m:
                code_text = m.group('code').strip()
                inlines.append(Code(Attr(), code_text))
                i += len(m.group(0))
                continue

        # Footnote ref: [^1]
        if text[i:i+2] == '[^':
            m = re.match(r'^\[\^([^\]]+)\]', text[i:])
            if m:
                fn_id = m.group(1)
                if footnotes_map and fn_id in footnotes_map:
                    fn_blocks = footnotes_map[fn_id]
                    inlines.append(Note(fn_blocks))
                else:
                    # Generic note placeholder
                    inlines.append(Note([Para([Str(fn_id)])]))
                i += len(m.group(0))
                continue

        # Image: ![alt](url "title")
        if text[i:i+2] == '![':
            m = re.match(r'^!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^"\'\s)]+)(?:\s+["\']([^"\'\)]*)["\'])?\)', text[i:])
            if m:
                alt = m.group(1)
                url = m.group(2)
                title = m.group(3) or ""
                alt_inlines = parse_inlines(alt, footnotes_map)
                inlines.append(Image(Attr(), alt_inlines, [url, title]))
                i += len(m.group(0))
                continue

        # Link: [text](url "title")
        if text[i] == '[':
            m = re.match(r'^\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^"\'\s)]+)(?:\s+["\']([^"\'\)]*)["\'])?\)', text[i:])
            if m:
                link_text = m.group(1)
                url = m.group(2)
                title = m.group(3) or ""
                lbl_inlines = parse_inlines(link_text, footnotes_map)
                inlines.append(Link(Attr(), lbl_inlines, [url, title]))
                i += len(m.group(0))
                continue

        # Bold / Italic / Strikeout / Super / Sub
        # Bold: ** or __
        if text[i:i+2] in ('**', '__'):
            tag = text[i:i+2]
            idx = text.find(tag, i+2)
            if idx != -1:
                inner = text[i+2:idx]
                inlines.append(Strong(parse_inlines(inner, footnotes_map)))
                i = idx + 2
                continue
                
        # Strikeout: ~~
        if text[i:i+2] == '~~':
            idx = text.find('~~', i+2)
            if idx != -1:
                inner = text[i+2:idx]
                inlines.append(Strikeout(parse_inlines(inner, footnotes_map)))
                i = idx + 2
                continue

        # Italic: * or _
        if text[i] in ('*', '_'):
            tag = text[i]
            # Make sure not preceded/followed by space
            idx = text.find(tag, i+1)
            if idx != -1 and idx > i + 1:
                inner = text[i+1:idx]
                inlines.append(Emph(parse_inlines(inner, footnotes_map)))
                i = idx + 1
                continue

        # Superscript: ^
        if text[i] == '^':
            idx = text.find('^', i+1)
            if idx != -1 and idx > i + 1:
                inner = text[i+1:idx]
                inlines.append(Superscript(parse_inlines(inner, footnotes_map)))
                i = idx + 1
                continue

        # Subscript: ~
        if text[i] == '~' and (i == 0 or text[i-1] != '~') and (i + 1 < n and text[i+1] != '~'):
            idx = text.find('~', i+1)
            if idx != -1 and idx > i + 1:
                inner = text[i+1:idx]
                inlines.append(Subscript(parse_inlines(inner, footnotes_map)))
                i = idx + 1
                continue

        # Raw HTML tag: <tag ...>
        if text[i] == '<':
            m = re.match(r'^<[^>]+>', text[i:])
            if m:
                inlines.append(RawInline("html", m.group(0)))
                i += len(m.group(0))
                continue

        # Space
        if text[i] in (' ', '\t'):
            if not inlines or not isinstance(inlines[-1], Space):
                inlines.append(Space())
            i += 1
            continue

        # SoftBreak / LineBreak
        if text[i] == '\n':
            if not inlines or not isinstance(inlines[-1], (SoftBreak, LineBreak)):
                inlines.append(SoftBreak())
            i += 1
            continue

        # Normal character / word
        m = re.match(r'^[^\s\`\*\_\[\]\(\)\!\~\^\$\<\>\\\#]+', text[i:])
        if m:
            word = m.group(0)
            inlines.append(Str(word))
            i += len(word)
        else:
            inlines.append(Str(text[i]))
            i += 1

    return inlines

def read_markdown(text):
    existing_ids = set()
    meta_dict = {}
    footnotes_map = {}

    lines = text.splitlines()
    n = len(lines)
    i = 0

    # Parse YAML front matter if present
    if n > 0 and lines[0].rstrip() == '---':
        i = 1
        yaml_lines = []
        while i < n and lines[i].rstrip() not in ('---', '...'):
            yaml_lines.append(lines[i])
            i += 1
        if i < n:
            i += 1 # skip closing --- / ...
            
        # Parse simple YAML key-values
        curr_key = None
        for yl in yaml_lines:
            yl_s = yl.strip()
            if not yl_s or yl_s.startswith('#'):
                continue
            if yl.startswith('  - ') or yl.startswith('- '):
                val = yl_s[2:].strip()
                if curr_key in meta_dict and isinstance(meta_dict[curr_key], list):
                    meta_dict[curr_key].append(val)
                else:
                    meta_dict[curr_key] = [val]
            elif ':' in yl_s:
                k, v = yl_s.split(':', 1)
                curr_key = k.strip()
                v_s = v.strip()
                if v_s:
                    meta_dict[curr_key] = v_s
                else:
                    meta_dict[curr_key] = []

    # First pass: collect footnote definitions
    # e.g., [^1]: Note text
    fn_lines = []
    clean_lines = []
    j = i
    while j < n:
        line = lines[j]
        m = re.match(r'^\[\^([^\]]+)\]:\s*(.*)$', line)
        if m:
            fn_id = m.group(1)
            fn_text = m.group(2)
            j += 1
            while j < n and (lines[j].startswith('    ') or lines[j].startswith('\t') or not lines[j].strip()):
                fn_text += '\n' + lines[j]
                j += 1
            footnotes_map[fn_id] = [Para(parse_inlines(fn_text))]
        else:
            clean_lines.append(line)
            j += 1

    lines = clean_lines
    n = len(lines)
    i = 0
    blocks = []

    while i < n:
        line = lines[i]
        line_s = line.strip()

        if not line_s:
            i += 1
            continue

        # Fenced code block: ``` or ~~~
        m_fence = re.match(r'^(?P<fence>`{3,}|~{3,})\s*(?P<info>.*)$', line)
        if m_fence:
            fence = m_fence.group('fence')
            info = m_fence.group('info').strip()
            code_lines = []
            i += 1
            while i < n and not lines[i].startswith(fence[:3]):
                code_lines.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            if i < n:
                i += 1 # skip end fence
            classes = [info] if info else []
            attr = Attr("", classes, [])
            blocks.append(CodeBlock(attr, "\n".join(code_lines)))
            continue

        # ATX Header: # Title
        m_hdr = re.match(r'^(#{1,6})\s+(.*?)(?:\s+#+)?(?:\s+\{(.*?)\})?$', line)
        if m_hdr:
            level = len(m_hdr.group(1))
            title_text = m_hdr.group(2).strip()
            attr_str = m_hdr.group(3)
            
            inls = parse_inlines(title_text, footnotes_map)
            plain_title = inlines_to_string(inls)
            
            if attr_str:
                attr = parse_header_attr(attr_str)
                if not attr.identifier:
                    attr.identifier = make_auto_identifier(plain_title, existing_ids)
                else:
                    existing_ids.add(attr.identifier)
            else:
                ident = make_auto_identifier(plain_title, existing_ids)
                attr = Attr(ident, [], [])

            blocks.append(Header(level, attr, inls))
            i += 1
            continue

        # Setext Header: Title \n === or ---
        if i + 1 < n:
            next_s = lines[i+1].strip()
            if next_s and (set(next_s) == {'='} or set(next_s) == {'-'}):
                level = 1 if '=' in next_s else 2
                inls = parse_inlines(line_s, footnotes_map)
                plain_title = inlines_to_string(inls)
                ident = make_auto_identifier(plain_title, existing_ids)
                blocks.append(Header(level, Attr(ident, [], []), inls))
                i += 2
                continue

        # Horizontal Rule: ---, ***, ___
        if line_s in ('---', '***', '___', '- - -', '* * *', '_ _ _'):
            blocks.append(HorizontalRule())
            i += 1
            continue

        # Blockquote: > line
        if line_s.startswith('>'):
            bq_lines = []
            while i < n and (lines[i].strip().startswith('>') or (lines[i].strip() and not lines[i].startswith('#'))):
                l_s = lines[i].strip()
                if l_s.startswith('>'):
                    l_s = l_s[1:].lstrip()
                bq_lines.append(l_s)
                i += 1
            bq_text = "\n".join(bq_lines)
            sub_doc = read_markdown(bq_text)
            blocks.append(BlockQuote(sub_doc.blocks))
            continue

        # Bullet List: * , - , +
        if re.match(r'^[*\-\+]\s+', line_s):
            items = []
            while i < n and re.match(r'^[*\-\+]\s+', lines[i].strip()):
                item_line = lines[i].strip()[2:]
                item_lines = [item_line]
                i += 1
                while i < n and lines[i].startswith('  ') and not re.match(r'^[*\-\+]\s+', lines[i].strip()):
                    item_lines.append(lines[i].strip())
                    i += 1
                item_text = "\n".join(item_lines)
                
                # Check for task list
                m_task = re.match(r'^\[([ xX])\]\s*(.*)$', item_text)
                if m_task:
                    checked = m_task.group(1).lower() == 'x'
                    rest = m_task.group(2)
                    inls = parse_inlines(rest, footnotes_map)
                    items.append([Plain(inls)])
                else:
                    items.append([Plain(parse_inlines(item_text, footnotes_map))])
            blocks.append(BulletList(items))
            continue

        # Ordered List: 1. 
        if re.match(r'^\d+[\.\)]\s+', line_s):
            items = []
            m_start = re.match(r'^(\d+)[\.\)]\s+', line_s)
            start_num = int(m_start.group(1)) if m_start else 1
            while i < n and re.match(r'^\d+[\.\)]\s+', lines[i].strip()):
                item_line = re.sub(r'^\d+[\.\)]\s+', '', lines[i].strip())
                item_lines = [item_line]
                i += 1
                while i < n and lines[i].startswith('  ') and not re.match(r'^\d+[\.\)]\s+', lines[i].strip()):
                    item_lines.append(lines[i].strip())
                    i += 1
                items.append([Plain(parse_inlines("\n".join(item_lines), footnotes_map))])
            blocks.append(OrderedList([start_num, None, None], items))
            continue

        # Table: | col1 | col2 |
        if line_s.startswith('|') and '|' in line_s[1:]:
            table_lines = []
            while i < n and lines[i].strip().startswith('|'):
                table_lines.append(lines[i].strip())
                i += 1
            if len(table_lines) >= 2:
                # Parse pipe table
                headers = [c.strip() for c in table_lines[0].strip('|').split('|')]
                # skip separator line if table_lines[1] contains ---
                row_start = 1
                if '---' in table_lines[1]:
                    row_start = 2
                
                body_rows = []
                for tl in table_lines[row_start:]:
                    cells = [c.strip() for c in tl.strip('|').split('|')]
                    row_cells = []
                    for c in cells:
                        row_cells.append([["",[],[]], {"t":"AlignDefault"}, 1, 1, [Plain(parse_inlines(c, footnotes_map))]])
                    body_rows.append([["",[],[]], row_cells])
                
                head_cells = []
                for h in headers:
                    head_cells.append([["",[],[]], {"t":"AlignDefault"}, 1, 1, [Plain(parse_inlines(h, footnotes_map))]])
                head = [["",[],[]], [[["",[],[]], head_cells]]]
                colspecs = [[{"t":"AlignDefault"}, {"t":"ColWidthDefault"}] for _ in headers]
                body = [["",[],[]], 0, [], body_rows]
                
                blocks.append(Table(Attr(), None, colspecs, head, [body], None))
                continue

        if text[i] == '~' and (i == 0 or text[i-1] != '~') and (i + 1 < n and text[i+1] != '~'):
            idx = text.find('~', i+1)
            if idx != -1 and idx > i + 1:
                inner = text[i+1:idx]
                inlines.append(Subscript(parse_inlines(inner, footnotes_map)))
                i = idx + 1
                continue

        # Raw HTML tag: <tag ...>
        if text[i] == '<':
            m = re.match(r'^<[^>]+>', text[i:])
            if m:
                inlines.append(RawInline("html", m.group(0)))
                i += len(m.group(0))
                continue

        # Space
        if text[i] in (' ', '\t'):
            if not inlines or not isinstance(inlines[-1], Space):
                inlines.append(Space())
            i += 1
            continue

        # SoftBreak / LineBreak
        if text[i] == '\n':
            if not inlines or not isinstance(inlines[-1], (SoftBreak, LineBreak)):
                inlines.append(SoftBreak())
            i += 1
            continue

        # Normal character / word
        m = re.match(r'^[^\s\`\*\_\[\]\(\)\!\~\^\$\<\>\\\#]+', text[i:])
        if m:
            word = m.group(0)
            inlines.append(Str(word))
            i += len(word)
        else:
            inlines.append(Str(text[i]))
            i += 1

    return inlines

def read_markdown(text):
    existing_ids = set()
    meta_dict = {}
    footnotes_map = {}

    lines = text.splitlines()
    n = len(lines)
    i = 0

    # Parse YAML front matter if present
    if n > 0 and lines[0].rstrip() == '---':
        i = 1
        yaml_lines = []
        while i < n and lines[i].rstrip() not in ('---', '...'):
            yaml_lines.append(lines[i])
            i += 1
        if i < n:
            i += 1 # skip closing --- / ...
            
        # Parse simple YAML key-values
        curr_key = None
        for yl in yaml_lines:
            yl_s = yl.strip()
            if not yl_s or yl_s.startswith('#'):
                continue
            if yl.startswith('  - ') or yl.startswith('- '):
                val = yl_s[2:].strip()
                if curr_key in meta_dict and isinstance(meta_dict[curr_key], list):
                    meta_dict[curr_key].append(val)
                else:
                    meta_dict[curr_key] = [val]
            elif ':' in yl_s:
                k, v = yl_s.split(':', 1)
                curr_key = k.strip()
                v_s = v.strip()
                if v_s:
                    meta_dict[curr_key] = v_s
                else:
                    meta_dict[curr_key] = []

    # First pass: collect footnote definitions
    # e.g., [^1]: Note text
    fn_lines = []
    clean_lines = []
    j = i
    while j < n:
        line = lines[j]
        m = re.match(r'^\[\^([^\]]+)\]:\s*(.*)$', line)
        if m:
            fn_id = m.group(1)
            fn_text = m.group(2)
            j += 1
            while j < n and (lines[j].startswith('    ') or lines[j].startswith('\t') or not lines[j].strip()):
                fn_text += '\n' + lines[j]
                j += 1
            footnotes_map[fn_id] = [Para(parse_inlines(fn_text))]
        else:
            clean_lines.append(line)
            j += 1

    lines = clean_lines
    n = len(lines)
    i = 0
    blocks = []

    while i < n:
        line = lines[i]
        line_s = line.strip()

        if not line_s:
            i += 1
            continue

        # Fenced code block: ``` or ~~~
        m_fence = re.match(r'^(?P<fence>`{3,}|~{3,})\s*(?P<info>.*)$', line)
        if m_fence:
            fence = m_fence.group('fence')
            info = m_fence.group('info').strip()
            code_lines = []
            i += 1
            while i < n and not lines[i].startswith(fence[:3]):
                code_lines.append(lines[i])
                i += 1
            if i < n:
                i += 1 # skip end fence
            classes = [info] if info else []
            attr = Attr("", classes, [])
            blocks.append(CodeBlock(attr, "\n".join(code_lines)))
            continue

        # ATX Header: # Title
        m_hdr = re.match(r'^(#{1,6})\s+(.*?)(?:\s+#+)?(?:\s+\{(.*?)\})?$', line)
        if m_hdr:
            level = len(m_hdr.group(1))
            title_text = m_hdr.group(2).strip()
            attr_str = m_hdr.group(3)
            
            inls = parse_inlines(title_text, footnotes_map)
            plain_title = inlines_to_string(inls)
            
            if attr_str:
                attr = parse_header_attr(attr_str)
                if not attr.identifier:
                    attr.identifier = make_auto_identifier(plain_title, existing_ids)
                else:
                    existing_ids.add(attr.identifier)
            else:
                ident = make_auto_identifier(plain_title, existing_ids)
                attr = Attr(ident, [], [])

            blocks.append(Header(level, attr, inls))
            i += 1
            continue

        # Setext Header: Title \n === or ---
        if i + 1 < n:
            next_s = lines[i+1].strip()
            if next_s and (set(next_s) == {'='} or set(next_s) == {'-'}):
                level = 1 if '=' in next_s else 2
                inls = parse_inlines(line_s, footnotes_map)
                plain_title = inlines_to_string(inls)
                ident = make_auto_identifier(plain_title, existing_ids)
                blocks.append(Header(level, Attr(ident, [], []), inls))
                i += 2
                continue

        # Horizontal Rule: ---, ***, ___
        if line_s in ('---', '***', '___', '- - -', '* * *', '_ _ _'):
            blocks.append(HorizontalRule())
            i += 1
            continue

        # Blockquote: > line
        if line_s.startswith('>'):
            bq_lines = []
            while i < n and (lines[i].strip().startswith('>') or (lines[i].strip() and not lines[i].startswith('#'))):
                l_s = lines[i].strip()
                if l_s.startswith('>'):
                    l_s = l_s[1:].lstrip()
                bq_lines.append(l_s)
                i += 1
            bq_text = "\n".join(bq_lines)
            sub_doc = read_markdown(bq_text)
            blocks.append(BlockQuote(sub_doc.blocks))
            continue

        # Bullet List: * , - , +
        if re.match(r'^[*\-\+]\s+', line_s):
            items = []
            while i < n and re.match(r'^[*\-\+]\s+', lines[i].strip()):
                item_line = lines[i].strip()[2:]
                item_lines = [item_line]
                i += 1
                while i < n and lines[i].startswith('  ') and not re.match(r'^[*\-\+]\s+', lines[i].strip()):
                    item_lines.append(lines[i].strip())
                    i += 1
                item_text = "\n".join(item_lines)
                
                # Check for task list
                m_task = re.match(r'^\[([ xX])\]\s*(.*)$', item_text)
                if m_task:
                    checked = m_task.group(1).lower() == 'x'
                    rest = m_task.group(2)
                    inls = parse_inlines(rest, footnotes_map)
                    items.append([Plain(inls)])
                else:
                    items.append([Plain(parse_inlines(item_text, footnotes_map))])
            blocks.append(BulletList(items))
            continue

        # Ordered List: 1. 
        if re.match(r'^\d+[\.\)]\s+', line_s):
            items = []
            m_start = re.match(r'^(\d+)[\.\)]\s+', line_s)
            start_num = int(m_start.group(1)) if m_start else 1
            while i < n and re.match(r'^\d+[\.\)]\s+', lines[i].strip()):
                item_line = re.sub(r'^\d+[\.\)]\s+', '', lines[i].strip())
                item_lines = [item_line]
                i += 1
                while i < n and lines[i].startswith('  ') and not re.match(r'^\d+[\.\)]\s+', lines[i].strip()):
                    item_lines.append(lines[i].strip())
                    i += 1
                items.append([Plain(parse_inlines("\n".join(item_lines), footnotes_map))])
            blocks.append(OrderedList([start_num, None, None], items))
            continue

        # Table: | col1 | col2 |
        if line_s.startswith('|') and '|' in line_s[1:]:
            table_lines = []
            while i < n and lines[i].strip().startswith('|'):
                table_lines.append(lines[i].strip())
                i += 1
            if len(table_lines) >= 2:
                # Parse pipe table
                headers = [c.strip() for c in table_lines[0].strip('|').split('|')]
                # skip separator line if table_lines[1] contains ---
                row_start = 1
                if '---' in table_lines[1]:
                    row_start = 2
                
                body_rows = []
                for tl in table_lines[row_start:]:
                    cells = [c.strip() for c in tl.strip('|').split('|')]
                    row_cells = []
                    for c in cells:
                        row_cells.append([["",[],[]], {"t":"AlignDefault"}, 1, 1, [Plain(parse_inlines(c, footnotes_map))]])
                    body_rows.append([["",[],[]], row_cells])
                
                head_cells = []
                for h in headers:
                    head_cells.append([["",[],[]], {"t":"AlignDefault"}, 1, 1, [Plain(parse_inlines(h, footnotes_map))]])
                head = [["",[],[]], [[["",[],[]], head_cells]]]
                colspecs = [[{"t":"AlignDefault"}, {"t":"ColWidthDefault"}] for _ in headers]
                body = [["",[],[]], 0, [], body_rows]
                
                blocks.append(Table(Attr(), None, colspecs, head, [body], None))
                continue

        # Indented Code Block: 4 spaces
        if line.startswith('    ') or line.startswith('\t'):
            code_lines = []
            while i < n and (lines[i].startswith('    ') or lines[i].startswith('\t') or not lines[i].strip()):
                l = lines[i]
                if l.startswith('    '):
                    l = l[4:]
                elif l.startswith('\t'):
                    l = l[1:]
                code_lines.append(l)
                i += 1
            blocks.append(CodeBlock(Attr(), "\n".join(code_lines)))
            continue

        # Paragraph
        para_lines = [line_s]
        i += 1
        while i < n and lines[i].strip() and not lines[i].strip().startswith(('#', '```', '~~~', '>', '|', '---', '***', '___', '1.', '* ', '- ')):
            para_lines.append(lines[i].strip())
            i += 1

        para_text = " ".join(para_lines)
        inls = parse_inlines(para_text, footnotes_map)
        blocks.append(Para(inls))

    return Document(blocks, Meta(meta_dict))
EOF"}

import re
from pandoc.ast import (
    Document, Meta, Attr, Header, Para, Plain, CodeBlock,
    BulletList, OrderedList, Str, Space, SoftBreak, Emph, Strong, Code, Link
)

def read_rst(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    blocks = []
    i = 0
    n = len(lines)

    while i < n:
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if not line:
            i += 1
            continue

        # Header with underline: Title \n === or ---
        if i + 1 < n:
            next_line = lines[i+1].strip()
            if next_line and (set(next_line) in [{'='}, {'-'}, {'~'}, {'^'}]):
                level = 1 if '=' in next_line else 2
                inls = [Str(line)]
                ident = line.lower().replace(' ', '-')
                blocks.append(Header(level, Attr(ident, [], []), inls))
                i += 2
                continue

        # Bullet list
        if line.startswith('- ') or line.startswith('* '):
            items = []
            while i < n and (lines[i].strip().startswith('- ') or lines[i].strip().startswith('* ')):
                itm_text = lines[i].strip()[2:]
                items.append([Plain([Str(itm_text)])])
                i += 1
            blocks.append(BulletList(items))

import re
from pandoc.ast import (
    Document, Meta, Attr, Header, Para, Plain, CodeBlock, BlockQuote,
    BulletList, OrderedList, Str, Space, SoftBreak, Emph, Strong, Code, Link
)

def read_latex(text):
    blocks = []
    lines = text.splitlines()
    n = len(lines)
    i = 0

    while i < n:
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('%'):
            i += 1
            continue

        # \section{Title}
        m_sec = re.match(r'^\\(section|subsection|subsubsection)\{(.*?)\}', line)
        if m_sec:
            cmd = m_sec.group(1)
            title = m_sec.group(2)
            lvl = 1 if cmd == 'section' else (2 if cmd == 'subsection' else 3)
            ident = title.lower().replace(' ', '-')
            blocks.append(Header(lvl, Attr(ident, [], []), [Str(title)]))
            i += 1
            continue

        # \begin{itemize}
        if line.startswith('\\begin{itemize}'):
            i += 1
            items = []
            while i < n and not lines[i].strip().startswith('\\end{itemize}'):
                l = lines[i].strip()
                if l.startswith('\\item'):
                    itm_txt = l[5:].strip()
                    items.append([Plain([Str(itm_txt)])])
                i += 1
            if i < n:
                i += 1
            blocks.append(BulletList(items))
            continue

        # Paragraph
        para_lines = [line]
        i += 1
        while i < n and lines[i].strip() and not lines[i].strip().startswith('\\'):
            para_lines.append(lines[i].strip())
            i += 1
        p_text = " ".join(para_lines)
        # Parse basic \textbf, \emph, \texttt
        inls = []
        words = p_text.split()
        for w in words:
            if '\\textbf{' in w:
                w_clean = re.sub(r'\\textbf\{(.*?)\}', r'\1', w)
                inls.append(Strong([Str(w_clean)]))
            elif '\\emph{' in w:
                w_clean = re.sub(r'\\emph\{(.*?)\}', r'\1', w)
                inls.append(Emph([Str(w_clean)]))
            elif '\\texttt{' in w:
                w_clean = re.sub(r'\\texttt\{(.*?)\}', r'\1', w)
                inls.append(Code(Attr(), w_clean))
            else:
                inls.append(Str(w))
            inls.append(Space())
        if inls and isinstance(inls[-1], Space):
            inls.pop()
        blocks.append(Para(inls))

    return Document(blocks, Meta())
